models.name: pair-based spike-timing-dependent plasticity
models.description: A simplified rule where weight changes depend on pre/post spike timing.
models.equation: delta_w = A_plus*exp(-dt/tau_plus) if dt>0; -A_minus*exp(dt/tau_minus) if dt<0
assumptions: dt is postsynaptic spike time minus presynaptic spike time
weight bounds and update schedule must be specified
models.evidence_note: Simplified model family; not a universal rule for all human synapses.

models.name: co-dependent excitatory/inhibitory plasticity
models.description: Optional model in which local excitatory and inhibitory context influences plasticity.
models.evidence_note: Inspired by a published theoretical framework; needs implementation and validation.
